VERDICT: ACCEPT
I completed independent pass 1 of candidate b28cbd6f1a2d95eb468d09d5cef9fa74a1807917, confirmed HEAD and the pinned spec hash, inspected the full diff and touched files/tests, and made no edits.
Per-criterion verdicts: AC-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:68-74; test/math.test.mjs:85-103); R-1 satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71; test/math.test.mjs:91-98); R-2 satisfied (src/math.mjs:72-74; test/math.test.mjs:99-103); R-3 satisfied (base-to-candidate diff preserves existing functions at src/math.mjs:1-66 and existing cases at test/math.test.mjs:5-83, changing only the allowed import at test/math.test.mjs:3); R-4 satisfied (package.json:1 unchanged, no dependency or generated-file changes); R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,99); findings: LOW at test/math.test.mjs:85-89, every successful candidate max example has its maximum first, so returning only the first element would pass and the update branch at src/math.mjs:73 has no regression protection, verify fixed by adding a max-prefixed assertion that max([1,3,2]) equals 3; LOW at test/math.test.mjs:95-97, positive Infinity is not tested although NaN and negative Infinity are, leaving that non-finite subcase unprotected, verify fixed by adding a max-prefixed assertion that max([1,Infinity]) throws TypeError.
Checks run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^max" test/ exited 0 with "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (15 !== 10), as expected by the brief; separate read-only reviewer probes reported "Reviewer probes: 5 passed (later maximum, negative values, positive Infinity, sparse array, frozen input)", which confirm behavior but do not repair candidate test coverage; remaining uncertainty: none blocking this review, the two low coverage gaps remain, and acceptance is the coordinator's decision.
